summary: Former lookout on Shawnee State Forest, Scioto County, OH (US 1583), 87 ft tall; under construction Oct 1934 by CCC enrollees; listed as gone.

facts.status_note: Listed as gone on the Forest Fire Lookout Association's Ohio list; no source we read describes what remains at the site.

events.note: Under construction on October 27, 1934 per Chillicothe Gazette note; Scioto Historical credits enrollees from Camp Scioto. No completion date found.

evidence.supports: administered by the Ohio Department of Natural Resources
October 27, 1934 note: tower being built on Shawnee State Forest
evidence.quote: The Pond Run Tower now being built on the Shawnee State Forest.

evidence.supports: enrollees from Camp Scioto built the Pond Run Fire Tower
evidence.quote: It was enrollees from Camp Scioto that built the Pond Run Fire Tower, which long stood above the lake, offering a dramatic view of the forest and the Ohio River.

evidence.supports: CCC Company 552 at Camp Scioto on Pond Run
evidence.quote: CCC Co. 552, which made its home at Camp Scioto on Pond Run

evidence.supports: Civilian Conservation Corps abbreviated as CCC
the lake the Camp Scioto enrollees built is McBride Lake, on Pond Run
evidence.quote: built McBride Lake in the headwaters of Pond Run

evidence.supports: Ohio list marks Pond Run as Tower Gone

resolved_conflicts.explanation: The October 1934 Gazette note says the tower was still being built, and the Scioto Historical page credits CCC enrollees. The two fit together; no completion date was found.

notes_for_editor: Thin record. No staffing, fire or removal date found. Height 87 ft comes from the register only. Shawnee State Forest and ODNR administration come from the register; no source we read says whether the site is open. The Scioto Historical page describes the tower in the past tense and dates the camp's lake work to the mid-1930s, not the tower's completion. The register gives height in feet only; 26.5 m is converted from 87 ft.
